scripts.dev: npx -y concurrently -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND,ADMIN" -c "cyan,green,yellow" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix admin run dev"
scripts.dev:windows: start cmd /k npm --prefix frontend run dev && start cmd /k npm --prefix backend run dev && start cmd /k npm --prefix admin run dev
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix frontend && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix admin
